summary.text: Ballotpedia lists Karl Rhoads as a Democratic member of the Hawaii State Senate representing District 13 since 2016, after representing House District 29 from 2006 to 2016.

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Rhoads announced in October 2025 that he would not run for re-election in 2026.
A legislature biography written while Rhoads was a state representative says he was born on January 24, 1963, and took part in the Chinatown Citizens Patrol and the Downtown Neighborhood Board.

It says he received a B.A. in history from Andrews University in 1986, an M.A. in Soviet and Eastern European Area Studies from the University of London in 1987, and a J.D. from George Washington University in 1996.
